title: Private equity firm Apollo confirms data breach amid hacking wave targeting financial giants | TechCrunch
summary: Private equity giant Apollo Global Management has confirmed a data breach in which hackers stole reams of personal information from the company’s cloud systems. The hackers took names, birth dates, contact information, including home addresses, and Social Security numbers.
